description: Update the API route to also handle the missing RIOT_API_KEY case (RiotApiError with status 500 and message 'RIOT_API_KEY is not configured') with the same user-friendly 503 response that is already used for 401/403. Currently the 401/403 case is handled, but when the env var is completely missing, the error message 'RIOT_API_KEY is not configured' leaks to the client. The fix should treat this as a service availability issue and return the same friendly message.
steps: In app/api/riot/route.ts, within the catch block that handles RiotApiError, expand the if condition that checks for status 401 or 403 to also catch the case where the error message indicates the API key is not configured (status 500 with message 'RIOT_API_KEY is not configured'). Alternatively, add a separate condition checking for this specific error message or a check for error.message.includes('RIOT_API_KEY') to return the same 503 user-friendly response.
Ensure that npm run build passes with zero errors.
Ensure that npm run lint passes with zero errors.
acceptance_criteria: When RIOT_API_KEY env var is not set, the /api/riot endpoint returns status 503 with body { error: 'Service temporarily unavailable, please try again later', status: 503 }
When RIOT_API_KEY is set but expired (401/403 from Riot), the endpoint still returns the same 503 response (existing behavior preserved)
npm run build completes without errors
npm run lint completes without errors
